coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 9 ground-truth variable groups (33%): the p-logP/QED/affinity property set, baseline versus pretrained and chemical-feedback-finetuned model configurations, and structural diversity including long carbon chains. The model-configuration match is broad rather than MOLGEN-specific.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Omits the specified pipeline scripts, constant DeepSpeed framework, ESR1/ACAA1 targets, and synthetic versus natural-product domains. Reports distributional property statistics instead of top-three scores and omits the target-specific affinity improvements of approximately 96.7% and 70.4%. Substitutes a generic CPU generator and affinity surrogate for the intended MOLGEN experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing all expected conclusions: exceptionally high p-logP up to 80.30, maintained or improved QED, lower KD with ESR1/ACAA1 improvements, reduced molecular hallucinations, and maintained molecular diversity.
